text: Geology is a fundamental science that studies the composition of the Earth's materials, its internal structure, evolutionary history, and the formation process of the Earth's surface features. It is known as "the chronicle of the Earth". By observing natural phenomena such as rocks, fossils, strata, and landforms, it reveals the mysteries of the Earth's 4.6-billion-year evolution and provides scientific basis for resource exploration, environmental governance, and disaster warning. From the uplift of the Himalayas to the cause of the extinction of dinosaurs, from the formation of oil to the occurrence of earthquakes, all fall within the scope of geological research.
